items.title: Mr. X Interview, 1961-03-18
items.q: And Fanny Bloom is 1405 Custom House.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Ida Bernstein is old, hard to read. 1566 Custom House Street. Julia Dean is... 341 North Basin. Connor Conti. And Fanny Bloom is 1405 Custom House. And Miss Selma, I believe that is... No, it's Sabina.
